_comment: Things you know that the model does not. Edit, commit, push — the daily rebuild picks it up. Anything left null is worked out automatically.
_keep: Players the plan may never sell, by name as shown in FPL. Use it for a decision you have already made — a premium you will not move on a marginal signal, or a player you are holding through a bad run. Empty means the model decides.
_free_transfers: null works it out from your transfer history, which is right unless you have made a transfer since the last gameweek was scored. Set 1-5 to override.
_note: Free text shown on the dashboard, for reminding yourself why something is set.
